_comment: pc/boat-slots: the hero J/22's flat hardware materials (materials.json flat_materials, M_BoatSurface) folded into packs of up to 8, one slot each; the entry is in UV1.x and MI_J22H_<Pack> on M_BoatPacked holds the entries' values (scripts/import_j22_hero.py).
